messages:
oncall-bot: [ALERT] High paging observed on 'runtime-pool-3' (pager: paging-surge). Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/1777777777
sam: I'm on call, looking. Which services and customers?
eva: Seeing repeated GPU page-fault spikes on nodes gpu-83,gpu-85. Initial impact: increased latency and a few OOMs.
priya: Looks like KV cache growth combined with large batch sizes. Hypothesis: working set > GPU, causing NVMe paging.
leo: Running quick telemetry pull for gpu-83 now.
leo: ```
GPU  PID   USED_MB  FREE_MB  kv_cache_mb  pagefaults
83   4210  14321    37679    12200        4523
85   4398  15012    36988    12840        5121
``` 
sam: thanks. Customer impact? cs-amy, any reports?
cs-amy: CS note: 3 customers reported 5-12s tail latency increases; one production tenant (AcmeCorp) saw 15% request errors during the window.
ops-sre: tagging logs and creating timeline. Please paste any stack traces or model batch logs here.
leo: sending a short log extract from gpu-83:
leo: ```
2026-03-17T14:05:12Z WARN runtime: page-fault count 120 (delta 60)
2026-03-17T14:05:14Z ERROR kvcache: eviction failed to reclaim desired bytes (requested 2GB, reclaimed 200MB)
2026-03-17T14:05:15Z ERROR runtime: OOM while allocating kv cache page: 0x7f8a
``` 
priya: Actionable mitigations: 1) lower batch_size from 16 -> 6 on runtime-pool-3; 2) enforce aggressive kvcache eviction for older prefixes; 3) enable sampling of context-length distribution.
sam: can we push batch-size change as a config override on the pool? Prefer quick config toggle over full deploy.
leo: I'll push override now: `curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/pools/runtime-pool-3 -d '{"batch_size":6}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'`
deploy-bot: Rollout started for pool runtime-pool-3: override.batch_size=6 — 6 nodes affected.
sam: monitoring metrics. ops-sre please collect pre/post delta (pagefaults, reclaimed bytes, tail latency)
ops-sre: capturing: sampling window started 2026-03-17T14:10:00Z
priya: tagging hypotheses in-thread:
- H1: KV cache fragmentation -> failed eviction -> pages moved to host -> paging surge
- H2: High batchsize + long contexts -> working set expansion beyond GPU
- H3: Kernel-level memory fragmentation causing allocation rejection
sam: timeline (will refine):
- 14:04 pager triggered (page-fault surge)
- 14:07 initial oncall ack
- 14:10 batch_size override rolled out
- 14:16 observed drop in pagefault rate
leo: post-override GPU stats:
leo: ```
GPU  PID   USED_MB  FREE_MB  kv_cache_mb  pagefaults
83   4210  12512    39488    10640        820
85   4398  12900    39100    10900        950
``` 
cs-amy: customers alerted. AcmeCorp acknowledged and is in monitoring, no further errors reported.
sam: early conclusion: batch_size reduction reduced working set; eviction became more effective; paging events dropped. Still tracking fragmentation metrics — ops-sre to run defrag job as precaution.
ops-sre: scheduled KV defrag job against runtime-pool-3 at 02:00 UTC tonight; will capture before/after traces.
sam: assigning owners: priya (hypothesis tracking & RCA draft), leo (logs + patch notes), ops-sre (defrag + traces), cs-amy (customer comms).
sam: closing incident thread to "monitoring" state. If paging spikes again, re-open. :white_check_mark:
